entities.name: Asier Etxeandía
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Asier Gómez Etxeandia is a Spanish film actor and singer, whose career includes television, theater and film performances. He is best known for his character as Raúl de la Riva in Velvet and Velvet Colección and for Pain and Glory (2019), for which he was nominated for Goya Award for Best Supporting Actor.
